text: This video builds the layer every team actually touches: the marts. member_activity_mart and revenue_mart are the governed tables Power BI and every team will query from here on.
member_activity_mart rolls the daily active-member model up to one row per member per month. revenue_mart joins billing to that same foundation, attributing revenue by location and plan.
The monthly rollup picks each member's most recent location that month, a documented choice for anyone who transferred -- so the shape matches what Power BI actually needs to show.
Documentation closes the loop: a description on every mart column, and a doc block that explains the active-member definition in plain language, visible in dbt docs generate.
The two governed tables are live. Next: putting this whole project under version control, with a CI check that runs on every change.
